info.title: Campus Service API
info.description: Bearer JWT authorization. Global ADMIN manages accounts/roles; ACADEMIC_AFFAIRS, CAMPUS_SERVICES and FINANCE operate their department domains with explicit read references. AUDITOR is read-only for audits, reports and approved references. See docs/permissions.md for the full method/path matrix and department ownership.

CANCELLED is terminal; financial snapshot is immutable.

RELEASED is terminal; expectedVersion required; references immutable.

post.summary: Record a grade for an enrollment (administrative permission)
post.description: Weights are derived from the course group and final-project flag. Scores are on the ten-point scale; a duplicate grade returns 409.

put.description: Requires expectedVersion from the last read; stale versions and duplicate codes return 409.

get.summary: Registration window, cohort slot and available sections of the signed-in student
get.description: Cohorts enter in two-day slots ordered oldest first (K21 and earlier together). Each section carries a blocked reason when it cannot be chosen.

post.summary: Register the signed-in student in a section
post.description: Requires the term, offering and section to be open and the student's cohort slot to be current. Rejects duplicates, full sections, unmet prerequisites and timetable conflicts.

post.summary: Record a manual VND payment (administrative permission)
post.description: Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe; replaying a key with the same payload returns the original payment.

post.summary: Create a VND fee definition (administrative permission)
Create a Student obligation from an active fee snapshot (administrative permission)

post.summary: Add a course to a program curriculum (administrative permission)
post.description: A program can list each course once. Semester index is 1–12; the prerequisite must be an existing course.

delete.description: Only enrollments created through self-service can be withdrawn here, and only while the student's registration slot is open.
